approved_learn_contracts.scope: Same-parent generated integration pages whose output paths or slugs collide.
approved_learn_contracts.producer: The ingest collision resolver writes an explicit SEO title for every member using its source plugin identity.
approved_learn_contracts.consumer: The document metadata renderer prefers the explicit SEO title before the body-derived title.
approved_learn_contracts.failure_mode: Ingest fails when any member is not a generated integration, has no source plugin identity, or still has a duplicate SEO title.
